headline: A tour-shaped swing — the measurements mostly sit inside the pro bands.

sections.title: What lined up well
sections.body: Inside the typical tour spread: how open the hips are at impact, how much the upper body leans at setup, how much the upper body leans at impact, how bent the lead knee is at setup, how much the hips slide toward the target, the rhythm of the swing.

sections.title: Worth a look
sections.body: Your how far the shoulders rotate at the top measured less than most tour swings. Your how far the hips rotate at the top measured less than most tour swings. Your the gap between shoulder turn and hip turn at the top measured less than most tour swings. Your how much the spine angle changes from setup to impact measured less than most tour swings.

sections.title: How to read this
sections.body: Every number here is measured from your video against a 400-swing tour reference — nothing is estimated by the AI. Ask the coach about any metric for the full story.
